errors.evidence: The description invents properties for the horizontal axis. The axis is not explicitly scaled from 0 to 10 (the data range is -1.5 to 9.5), and there are no tick marks at intervals of 1. The chart only shows a central line at the zero position.
The description lists the numerical values for eight of the nine categories but omits the value for the first category, "NEWK OECD vs. 55", which is 7,8.
